title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Nkwado okwu n'okpuru n'okpuru nke dị mma na ndoro ndoro
bridge: Na English, nkwado okwu n'okpuru n'okpuru nke dị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na adverbs nke ndoro (e.g., 'somewhat', 'arguably'), modals nke ndoro (e.g., 'might', 'could'), na nkọwa ndoro (e.g., 'although', 'while'). N'okpuru Spanish, ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na subjunctives (n'ihi na, n'ihi na, n'ihi na), English na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro. N'ihi na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro, n'ihi na English na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma. N'ihi na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro, n'ihi na English na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma.
rule: Iji nkwado okwu n'okpuru n'okpuru nke dị mma na English na level C1, hụ na: 1) Adverbs nke ndoro (e.g., 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') iji kpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro nke onye na-eme ka okwu. 2) Modals nke ndoro (might, may, could) iji kpọtụrụ ndoro ndoro nke ndoro. 3) Connectors nke ndoro (although, even though, while, whereas) iji nkwado okwu n'okpuru n'okpuru. 4) Structures nke dị ka 'it could be argued that...', 'one might say that...', 'this is not to say that...' iji nkwado okwu n'okpuru n'okpuru. Hụ na ndoro ndoro nke okwu: na English, ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma, mana ọ bụghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma. Hụ na ndoro ndoro nke 'maybe' (informal) na contexts nke dị mma; hụ na 'perhaps' ma ọ bụ 'possibly'.

common_error.explanation: Na Spanish, ọ bụrụ na ndoro ndoro na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na 'aunque... pero' iji nkwado ndoro ndoro, mana na English, ọ bụghị iji hụ 'although' na 'but' nwere ọnụ. Hụ na ụzọ ọ bụla. Ma 'aunque' na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na 'although'/'though' n'ime ndoro, na 'but' na-enyeghị n'ụzọ dịrị mma na ndoro ndoro n'ime ndoro ndoro.

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Ntuzu okpuru na nkà
bridge: Na Spanish, anyị na-egosi nkà n'okpuru ndoro ndoro na usoro dị ka 'eme ka', 'ọ dị mma ịtụle ya' ma ọ bụ okpuru subjuntivo. Na English, ị ga-eme ka ị nwere ike ịmụta okpuru modals (may, might, could) iji mee ka ọ dị mma, adverbs nke ndoro (highly, somewhat, arguably) na usoro ndoro ndoro (It is worth noting). Ọ bụrụ na ndoro nke a na-eme banyere 'must' na okpuru niile na Spanish bụ 'debe ser', n'ihi na na English, 'must' na-eme ka ọ dị mma nke ndoro ndoro, a na-eme ka ọ dị mma nke ndoro. Nke a na-eme ka ị ga-eme ka ị nwere ike ịmụta okpuru modals na adverbs nke ndoro ndoro iji mee ka ọ dị mma. Na English, ị na-eme ka ọ dị mma na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro.
rule: Iji nkà n'okpuru na English na C1 level, bido: 1) Okpuru modals iji mee ka ọ dị mma nke ndoro: 'must' (ndoro ndoro), 'may/might/could' (ndoro), 'can't' (ndoro ndoro). 2) Adverbs nke ndoro: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Usoro ndoro ndoro: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Okpuru ndoro: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (ndoro ndoro na 'I think'). 5) Connectors nke ndoro ndoro: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas'. Gbalịa ịgụ 'I think' na ndoro ndoro na ndoro ndoro; bido 'This implies that...' ma ọ bụ 'It could be inferred that...'. Iji nkà, bido 'strengths and weaknesses', 'implications', 'limitations'.

Na English ndoro ndoro, ị ga-eme ka ị nwere ike ịmụta okpuru modals na adverbs nke ndoro ndoro iji mee ka ọ dị mma, ma ị gbalịa ịgụ 'I think' na ndoro ndoro akademikị. title: Irony and Understatement / Ironía, sarcasmo na eufemismo
bridge: NꞌIgbo, ironía, sarcasmo na eufemismo na-akwado na ntughari na mkpuruokwu ndoro ndoro (dị ka 'ndoro', 'nke a ga-eme', 'banyere a'), ma na-akwado na-eme ntinye ma obiara na-eme nnyocha. NꞌEnglish, ironía na-achọpụta na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ, na eufemismo bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. Nke a bụ ọtụtụ: nꞌEnglish, understatement bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro (dị ka 'not bad' tụọrọ 'mma'). NꞌIgbo, ndị a na-achọta na-eme nnyocha ma na-eme nnyocha ma na-eme nnyocha. Ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-akwado ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, ị nwere ike ịmalite ịnweta ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.
rule: NꞌEnglish na level C1, ironía na eufemismo na-achọpụta na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ: 1) Understatement: na-akwado adịective ma ọ bụ adverbị nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke (dị ka 'It's not the worst idea' tụọrọ 'ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mma'; 'a bit' ma ọ bụ 'slightly' tụọrọ nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke na-akwado). 2) Sarcasmo: na-akwado na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ (na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ). 3) Eufemismo: na-akwado mkpuruokwu ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro (dị ka 'passed away' tụọrọ 'were', 'let go' tụọrọ 'were fired', 'between jobs' tụọrọ 'were unemployed', 'full-figured' tụọrọ 'were fat'). Ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: adverbs nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke na-akwado nke (dị ka 'hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') tụọrọ understatement; nkọwa ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro (dị ka 'Is that so?') tụọrọ ironía; ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'just', 'only', 'a bit' tụọrọ ndoro ndoro ndoro. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro, ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro, 'I'm cold' na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro. Na C1, ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro. Ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro; '¿Puedes cerrar la ventana?' na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro 'Can you close the window?' mana na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro na-egosi na ndoro 'Would you mind closing the window?' ma 'Could you possibly close the window?'.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Ntuzuo ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro
bridge: Na Igbo, anyị na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro dị ka 'nke mbụ', 'na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro' ma ọ bụ 'na nke zuru ezu' iji mepụta okwu. Na English, nke a bụ nke dị mfe ma dị n'okpuru, na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro dị ka 'firstly', 'furthermore', 'but more importantly', na 'in light of this'. Ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro bụ na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'por un lado' dị ka 'on one side' na 'on the one hand', ma ọ bụ na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'in conclusion' n'ihi na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'to sum up' ma ọ bụ 'ultimately'. Na-enweghị ike, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.
rule: Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na English (C1), ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ma dị n'okpuru. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro dị ka 'I would like to begin by...', 'Let me start by...', ma ọ bụ 'The purpose of this presentation is to...'. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'Firstly', 'Secondly', 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'In addition'. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'Nevertheless'. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'Indeed', 'In fact', 'It is important to note that'. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'In conclusion', 'To summarize', 'In light of the evidence'. Ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro (p. ej., 'it's' na-eme ka 'it is') na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. Na-enweghị ike, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro 'we' (p. ej., 'we can see that...'). Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. Na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Mitigation na ike nke na-akpaghara akademia
bridge: Na Spanish, ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ nke subjunctive na okwu dị ka 'ọ bụ na' ma ọ bụ 'ọ bụ na' maka ịkpọgharị, mana na English akademia, hedging na-akpaghara na usoro dị icheiche na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ dị ka 'may', 'might' ma ọ bụ 'could', na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ dị ka 'suggest' ma ọ bụ 'appear'. N'ihi na n'okpuru, ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'it is possible that' na ndị Igbo, ọ na-akpaghị na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche. N'ihi na n'okpuru, ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'it is possible that' na ndị Igbo, ọ na-akpaghị na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche. N'ihi na n'okpuru, ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'it is possible that' na ndị Igbo, ọ na-akpaghị na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche na ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ dị icheiche.
rule: Na ndepụta akademia na English, ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ. Ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ. 1) Ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ: may, might, could (n'okpuru, 'This may indicate...'), 2) Ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (n'okpuru, 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ: suggest, appear, seem (n'okpuru, 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Na boosting, ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ. N'ihi na n'okpuru, ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'This clearly may be true' na English akademia, ọ na-akpaghị na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi na 'This clearly may be true' na English akademia. N'ihi na n'okpuru, na English akademia, ndị a na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ na-akpụ ụzọ.

common_error.explanation: N'ihi na n'okpuru, ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'may' na 'clearly' na ndepụta, ọ na-akpaghị na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi. Na Spanish, ndị a na-egosi na 'esto puede claramente mostrar', mana na English akademia, ị ga-achọ ịgụọ ọ bụla ma ọ bụ ọ bụla. Ife ọ bụla na-egosi na ọ bụrụ na ị na-egosi na 'may' na 'clearly', ọ na-akpaghị na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi na n'ihi na ọ na-egosi.
